title: 위층에 소음 항의하기: 밤에 잠을 자려야 잘 수가 없어요
objective: Politely raise a noise problem and say what you cannot do with V-(으)려야 V-(으)ㄹ 수가 없다.
summary: Practice a polite noise complaint with -(으)려야 -(으)ㄹ 수가 없다.
setting: About 10:30 p.m. at an apartment. A resident from unit 702 goes upstairs and knocks on the door of unit 802 because of running and jumping noise.

task.title: Make a polite complaint
task.line: Use the dialogue and the -(으)려야 pattern to choose, fill in, order, or write the right Korean.

words.example: 이 아파트는 층간 소음이 심한 편이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: Noise between floors in this apartment is pretty bad.

words.meaning: the reason I'm here/calling is… (polite way to start a request)
words.example: 다름이 아니라 택배가 저희 집에 잘못 왔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The reason I came is that your package was delivered to our place by mistake.
Don't run around inside the house.

words.meaning: to be careful (not to cause trouble)
words.exampleMeaning: At night I'll be careful to close the door quietly.

words.meaning: even if I try to V, I can't (something stops me). Same verb twice; after a consonant use -으려야 (먹다 → 먹으려야), after a vowel or ㄹ use -려야 (자다 → 자려야, 놀다 → 놀려야).
words.example: 배가 너무 불러서 더 먹으려야 먹을 수가 없어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm so full that I couldn't eat more even if I tried.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 밤늦게 죄송합니다. 아래층 702호에 사는 사람인데요.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. Sorry to bother you so late. I live downstairs in 702.

dialogue.korean: 다름이 아니라 요즘 밤마다 쿵쿵 뛰는 소리가 많이 나서요.
dialogue.meaning: The reason I came is that lately there's a lot of thudding, like running, every night.

dialogue.korean: 아이고, 아이들이 뛰어서 그런가 봐요. 죄송해요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh dear, it must be the kids running around. I'm sorry.

dialogue.korean: 저도 이해는 하는데요, 아침 일찍 출근해야 하는데 소리 때문에 잠을 자려야 잘 수가 없어요.
dialogue.meaning: I do understand, but I have to go to work early, and because of the noise I just can't sleep even if I try.

dialogue.korean: 정말 죄송합니다. 앞으로 10시 이후에는 안 뛰게 꼭 조심할게요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm really sorry. From now on, after 10 we'll make sure they don't run.

exercises: Choose the right form: 옆집 개가 계속 짖어서 공부를 (하려야 / 하더라도) 할 수가 없어요.
Fill in the blank with the -(으)려야 form of 참다: 윗집 음악 소리가 너무 커서 ____ 참을 수가 없어요.
Put the lines in order: (가) 앞으로 조금만 조심해 주시면 감사하겠습니다. (나) 안녕하세요, 아래층 302호에 사는 사람인데요. (다) 다름이 아니라 새벽마다 세탁기 소리가 들려서요.
Answer in Korean using 쉬다 and -(으)려야: Your upstairs neighbor moves furniture every night. Tell them you can't rest. 밤마다 가구 끄는 소리 때문에 ____.
answers: 쉬려야 쉴 수가 없어요 / 쉬려야 쉴 수 없어요
